content.comment_body: I am unable to connect with the [product_name] device using the latest [product_name] software version [version_no] and cable [article_no]. Is there any technical documentation or updated drivers for this cable that are compatible with the new software version?

There was previously a download for the USB driver on the [company_name] website, but after the website was redesigned, the download is no longer available. Since I have not needed to purchase a new [product_name] software version for some time and was able to update for free, I am unsure if the USB driver installation file is included on the installation CD or DVD. You might consider submitting a support request to ask for the driver.
You may be able to use the driver directly from Silabs, although I am not certain. The USB cable usually contains a Silabs CP2103 controller, as referenced in this [url]. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is experiencing issues connecting their [product_name] hardware to the latest [product_name] software due to missing updated USB drivers and technical documentation following changes on the [company_name] website. Other contributors confirm the change and recommend alternative sources for drivers, pointing out ongoing challenges in product support and access to documentation for new software releases.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking updated USB drivers and technical documentation that will allow for a smooth connection between their [product_name] hardware and the most recent [product_name] software version.
